ledgers.name: generated amount, path B (anti-join)
sql: SELECT SUM(a.amount) FROM agreements a JOIN agents g ON g.agent_id = a.agent_id
AND g.login NOT LIKE 'system%' AND g.login NOT LIKE 'test%'
AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM agreements n
WHERE n.agreement_id = a.agreement_id AND n.portfolio_id = a.portfolio_id
AND n.installment_no = a.installment_no AND n.row_id > a.row_id)

mappings.name: agreement status labels per portfolio
query: SELECT s.status_id AS code, s.label AS label, COUNT(*) AS rows_seen
JOIN agreement_statuses s ON s.status_id = a.status_id
JOIN agreement_debts d ON d.agreement_id = a.agreement_id AND d.portfolio_id = a.portfolio_id
JOIN debt_attributes da ON da.debt_id = d.debt_id
GROUP BY s.status_id, s.label ORDER BY s.status_id

mappings.name: contact result labels per portfolio
query: SELECT r.result_id AS code, r.label AS label, COUNT(*) AS events_seen
JOIN contact_results r ON r.result_id = e.result_id
JOIN debt_attributes da ON da.debt_id = e.debt_owner_id
GROUP BY r.result_id, r.label ORDER BY r.result_id
